args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

src/money.py's docstring claimed banker's rounding per FIN-212 but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail
in the nightly build. Switch to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build of `tests/test_money.py` expected banker's rounding, but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

This PR fixes the discrepancy by:
- Importing `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`
- Passing `rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to `quantize()`

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed: https://ci.example.com/runs/ci-0001

## References
- FIN-212
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
